# TileJSON-Quellen: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/tilejson-source/

> Orthophoto und Höhenlinien von mapx als TileJSON-Quellen ohne fertigen Stil in MapLibre GL JS einbinden: lauffähiger Beispielcode zum Kopieren.

Eine TileJSON-URL pro Produkt genügt: MapLibre liest Kachel-URL, Zoombereich und Attribution daraus. Hier ein eigener, minimaler Stil. OpenLayers liest das TileJSON nicht selbst: Die OpenLayers-Fassung lädt es per `fetch` und baut daraus `ol.source.XYZ` (Raster) und `ol.source.VectorTile` mit `ol.format.MVT` (Vektorkacheln).

## Code

Leaflet zeigt nur den Rasterteil: Vektorkacheln kann es ohne Plugin nicht, die Höhenlinien fehlen dort.

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Use TileJSON: orthophoto and contour lines as sources, without file names and without a style.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  attributionControl: false,
  transformRequest,
  container: 'map', center: [11.4, 47.27], zoom: 12.5, // Innsbruck
  style: {
    version: 8,
    sources: {
      ortho: { type: 'raster', url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/orthophoto.json', tileSize: 512 },
      linien: { type: 'vector', url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/contours.json' },
    },
    layers: [
      { id: 'ortho', type: 'raster', source: 'ortho' },
      { id: 'linien', type: 'line', source: 'linien', 'source-layer': 'contour_l', paint: { 'line-color': '#ffd24a', 'line-width': 0.8, 'line-opacity': 0.9 } },
    ],
  },
});
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Use TileJSON: orthophoto (raster) and contour lines (vector tiles, MVT) as sources, without file names and without a style.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; this example takes the text from each TileJSON.

const linie = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: 'rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.9)', width: 0.8 }) });
const ortho = new ol.layer.Tile(), linien = new ol.layer.VectorTile({ style: linie });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [ortho, linien], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([11.4, 47.27]), zoom: 13.5 }) }); // Innsbruck

const plain = (html) => new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').body.textContent; // attribution as text, not as HTML
async function tilejson(name, sep = '') {
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/${name}.json`, AUTH);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
  const tj = await r.json(); // tile URL, zoom range and attribution
  return { url: tj.tiles[0] + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, minZoom: tj.minzoom, maxZoom: tj.maxzoom, attributions: plain(tj.attribution ?? '') + sep, attributionsCollapsible: false };
}
(async () => {
  ortho.setSource(new ol.source.XYZ({ ...(await tilejson('orthophoto', '; ')), tileSize: 512 }));
  linien.setSource(new ol.source.VectorTile({ ...(await tilejson('contours')), format: new ol.format.MVT({ layers: ['contour_l'] }) }));
})();
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Use TileJSON: the orthophoto as a raster source, tile URL, zoom range and attribution come from the TileJSON.
// Leaflet has no vector tiles without a plugin, so the contour lines of the MapLibre version are missing here.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };

const map = L.map('map').setView([47.27, 11.4], 14); // Innsbruck
(async () => {
  const tj = await (await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/tiles/orthophoto.json', AUTH)).json();
  // the attribution text of the TileJSON (CC BY 4.0) must stay visible on the map; it contains HTML, so reduce it to plain text and escape it
  const plain = new DOMParser().parseFromString(tj.attribution ?? '', 'text/html').body.textContent;
  L.tileLayer(tj.tiles[0] + '?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: tj.minzoom + 1, maxNativeZoom: tj.maxzoom + 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: plain }).innerHTML }).addTo(map);
})();
````

Leaflet liest kein TileJSON von selbst: Die Leaflet-Fassung holt es mit `fetch` und übernimmt `tiles`, `minzoom`, `maxzoom` und `attribution`, zeigt aber nur das Orthophoto, denn Vektorkacheln wie die Höhenlinien kann Leaflet ohne Plugin nicht.

## Verwendete APIs

- [TileJSON](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/tiles.md) `orthophoto`, `contours`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (Leaflet)

---

# 3D-Gebäude: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/buildings-3d/

> Extrudierte 3D-Gebäude mit BEV-Höhen auf der mapx-Vektor-Basiskarte, Kamera geneigt, in MapLibre GL JS. Lauffähiger Code zum Kopieren.

Der Stil `streets` enthält eine extrudierte Gebäudeebene, die standardmäßig aus ist. Die Ebenen-IDs stehen in den Stil-Metadaten (`mapx:groups`), damit lässt sich eine ganze Gruppe einschalten, ohne die Namen zu kennen. Auf Zoom 15 oder höher gehen und die Karte kippen (rechte Maustaste oder zwei Finger).

## Code

3D-Gebäude gibt es nur in MapLibre; OpenLayers und Leaflet zeichnen flache Karten.

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// 3D buildings: switch on the extruded building layer of the streets style and tilt the camera.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 16.2, pitch: 62, bearing: -20 }); // Stephansplatz, Vienna
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)

map.on('style.load', () => {
  // The style lists its layer groups in the metadata, so no layer names are hard-coded.
  for (const id of map.getStyle().metadata['mapx:groups'].buildings3d) map.setLayoutProperty(id, 'visibility', 'visible');
});
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Styles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}`

# Search Box: Beispiel mit Vorschlägen

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/search-box/

> Vorschläge beim Tippen, Position nach dem Klick und Typfilter: Suche mit Autovervollständigung über die mapx-Search-Box-API, lauffähiger Code.

Die Search Box arbeitet in zwei Schritten: `suggest` liefert Vorschläge beim Tippen, `retrieve` die Position des gewählten. Für beide Aufrufe dasselbe `session_token` verwenden, für die nächste Suche ein neues. Der Typfilter begrenzt die Vorschläge.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [14.3, 47.6], zoom: 7 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker, token = crypto.randomUUID();

let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  const c = map.getCenter();
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${c.lng},${c.lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});

async function pick(id) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
  const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
  marker?.remove();
  marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(f.geometry.coordinates).addTo(map);
  map.flyTo({ center: f.geometry.coordinates, zoom: f.properties.zoom ?? 15 });
  list.replaceChildren();
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const hit = new ol.source.Vector(); // the chosen result
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([14.3, 47.6]), zoom: 8 }) });
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let token = crypto.randomUUID();

let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  const [lon, lat] = ol.proj.toLonLat(map.getView().getCenter());
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${lon},${lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});

async function pick(id) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    const at = ol.proj.fromLonLat(f.geometry.coordinates);
    hit.clear();
    hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(at)));
    map.getView().setCenter(at), map.getView().setZoom((f.properties.zoom ?? 15) + 1); // jump instead of animating: fewer tile requests
    list.replaceChildren();
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Search Box: suggestions while typing (suggest), position and details after the click (retrieve). One session token per search.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the search (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([47.6, 14.3], 8);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const input = document.getElementById('q'), types = document.getElementById('types'), list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker, token = crypto.randomUUID();
let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
input.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (input.value.trim().length < 2) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  const c = map.getCenter();
  const url = `https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}&session_token=${token}&proximity=${c.lng},${c.lat}&limit=6` + (types.value ? `&types=${types.value}` : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = `${s.name} (${s.feature_type}) ${s.place_formatted ?? ''}`;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => pick(s.mapbox_id));
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});
async function pick(id) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?session_token=${token}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    const [lng, lat] = f.geometry.coordinates;
    marker?.remove();
    marker = L.circleMarker([lat, lng], { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(map);
    map.setView([lat, lng], (f.properties.zoom ?? 15) + 1, { animate: false }); // jump instead of flying: fewer tile requests
    list.replaceChildren();
  } catch (e) { list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
  token = crypto.randomUUID(); // the session ends with retrieve
}
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Search Box](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/search-box.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest`
- [Search Box](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/search-box.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/retrieve/{id}`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Adress-Autofill im Formular: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/autofill/

> Straße tippen, Vorschlag wählen, die Formularfelder füllen sich: Adress-Autofill für österreichische Adressen mit der mapx-Autofill-API. Lauffähiger Code.

Autofill ist für Bestell- und Anmeldeformulare gedacht: ein Textfeld, eine Vorschlagsliste, und die übrigen Felder (Hausnummer, PLZ, Ort) werden aus dem gewählten Vorschlag gefüllt. Jeder Vorschlag bringt seine Koordinaten schon mit.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [13.8, 47.7], zoom: 6.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker;

let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        marker?.remove();
        marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(s.coordinates).addTo(map);
        map.flyTo({ center: s.coordinates, zoom: 16 });
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const hit = new ol.source.Vector(); // the chosen address
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([13.8, 47.7]), zoom: 7.5 }) });
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');

let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        const at = ol.proj.fromLonLat(s.coordinates);
        hit.clear();
        hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(at)));
        map.getView().setCenter(at), map.getView().setZoom(17); // jump instead of animating: fewer tile requests
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Address autofill: type a street and number, pick a suggestion, the form fields fill themselves.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the addresses (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/

L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const f = Object.fromEntries(['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place'].map((k) => [k, document.getElementById(k)]));
const list = document.getElementById('treffer');
let marker;
let ctrl; // AbortController of the running request
f.street.addEventListener('input', async () => {
  ctrl?.abort(); // a newer input cancels the older request
  if (f.street.value.trim().length < 3) { list.replaceChildren(); return; }
  ctrl = new AbortController();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=${encodeURIComponent(f.street.value)}&limit=5&session_token=demo`, { ...AUTH, signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const items = (await res.json()).suggestions;
    list.replaceChildren(); // clear only now, so fast typing never shows two lists
    for (const s of items) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = s.full_address;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        for (const k of Object.keys(f)) f[k].value = s[k] ?? '';
        const [lng, lat] = s.coordinates;
        marker?.remove();
        marker = L.circleMarker([lat, lng], { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(map);
        map.setView([lat, lng], 17, { animate: false }); // jump instead of flying: fewer tile requests
        list.replaceChildren();
      });
      li.append(b); list.append(li);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // replaced by a newer input
    list.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message;
  }
});
````

# Adressvalidierung: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/address-validation/

> Eine Adresse mit der Adressvalidierungs-API gegen das amtliche österreichische Adressregister prüfen und das korrigierte Ergebnis zeigen. Lauffähiger Code.

Die Validierung gleicht die vier Adressteile mit dem Adressregister des BEV ab. Das Ergebnis hat einen `status` (`match`, `corrected`, `ambiguous`, `not_found`), die Liste der `deviations` und entweder die passende `address` mit Koordinaten oder eine Liste von `candidates`. Die vorbelegte Adresse enthält absichtlich einen Tippfehler.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Address validation: check a typed address against the official register (BEV) and show the corrected result.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [13.8, 47.7], zoom: 6.5 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const out = document.getElementById('ergebnis');
let marker;

document.getElementById('pruefen').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of ['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place']) p.set(k, document.getElementById(k).value);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?' + p, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const r = await res.json(); // status: match, corrected, ambiguous, not_found
    const hit = r.address ? { text: r.address.full_address, at: r.coordinates } : r.candidates?.[0] && { text: r.candidates[0].full_address, at: r.candidates[0].coordinates };
    out.textContent = `Status: ${r.status}` + (r.deviations?.length ? `, ${de ? 'Abweichungen' : 'deviations'}: ${r.deviations.map((d) => `${d.field} ${d.input} > ${d.expected}`).join('; ')}` : '') + (hit ? `, ${r.address ? (de ? 'Adresse' : 'address') : (de ? 'erster Kandidat' : 'first candidate')}: ${hit.text}` : '');
    marker?.remove();
    if (hit) { marker = new maplibregl.Marker().setLngLat(hit.at).addTo(map); map.flyTo({ center: hit.at, zoom: 16 }); }
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">

```

````js
// Address validation: check a typed address against the official register (BEV) and show the corrected result.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

const hit = new ol.source.Vector(); // the validated address or first candidate
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: hit, style: pin('#3fb1ce') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([13.8, 47.7]), zoom: 7.5 }) });
const out = document.getElementById('ergebnis');

document.getElementById('pruefen').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of ['street', 'housenumber', 'postcode', 'place']) p.set(k, document.getElementById(k).value);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?' + p, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const r = await res.json(); // status: match, corrected, ambiguous, not_found
    const top = r.address ? { text: r.address.full_address, at: r.coordinates } : r.candidates?.[0] && { text: r.candidates[0].full_address, at: r.candidates[0].coordinates };
    out.textContent = `Status: ${r.status}` + (r.deviations?.length ? `, ${de ? 'Abweichungen' : 'deviations'}: ${r.deviations.map((d) => `${d.field} ${d.input} > ${d.expected}`).join('; ')}` : '') + (top ? `, ${r.address ? (de ? 'Adresse' : 'address') : (de ? 'erster Kandidat' : 'first candidate')}: ${top.text}` : '');
    hit.clear();
    if (top) { hit.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(top.at)))); map.getView().setCenter(ol.proj.fromLonLat(top.at)), map.getView().setZoom(17); }
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

'Abweichungen' : 'deviations'}: ${r.deviations.map((d) => `${d.field} ${d.input} > ${d.expected}`).join('; ')}` : '') + (hit ? `, ${r.address ? (de ? 'Adresse' : 'address') : (de ? 'erster Kandidat' : 'first candidate')}: ${hit.text}` : '');

````js
      marker = L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: '#2346d8', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(map);

    }
  } catch (e) { out.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + e.message; }
});
````

# Reverse Geocoding: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/reverse-geocode/

> Karte anklicken und die nächste Adresse erhalten: Reverse Geocoding mit der mapx-Geocoding-API für Österreich, lauffähiger Code mit MapLibre GL JS.

Reverse Geocoding macht aus einer Koordinate die nächste Adresse, Straße oder den nächsten Ort. `types` begrenzt die Art des Ergebnisses, `radius` die Suchdistanz in Metern.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 15 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const popup = new maplibregl.Popup({ closeButton: false });

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const { lng, lat } = e.lngLat;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText(f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby')).addTo(map);
  } catch (err) { popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setText((de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message).addTo(map); }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const label = document.createElement('div'); // OpenLayers has no popup of its own: an overlay with a plain element
label.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0006';
const popup = new ol.Overlay({ element: label, positioning: 'bottom-center', offset: [0, -8] });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base], overlays: [popup], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.3725, 48.2085]), zoom: 16 }) }); // Stephansplatz, Vienna

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const [lng, lat] = ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    label.textContent = f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby');
  } catch (err) { label.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
  popup.setPosition(e.coordinate);
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Reverse geocoding: click the map, get the nearest address, street or place.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the addresses (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2085, 16.3725], 16);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const popup = L.popup({ closeButton: false });
const show = (latlng, s) => popup.setLatLng(latlng).setContent(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: s })).openOn(map); // as text, not HTML
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  const { lng, lat } = e.latlng;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=${lng}&lat=${lat}&limit=1&types=address,street,place`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const f = (await res.json()).features[0];
    show(e.latlng, f ? f.place_name : (de ? 'In der Nähe nichts gefunden' : 'Nothing found nearby'));
  } catch (err) { show(e.latlng, (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message); }
});
````

- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)

# Lkw-Route: Beispiel mit Optionen

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/truck-route/

> Lkw-Routing mit Fahrzeugmaßen, Maut und Autobahn meiden sowie Alternativen: lauffähiges Beispiel für die mapx-Routing-API zum Kopieren.

Das Profil `driving-truck` mit Gewicht und Höhe wählen: Straßen mit passenden Verboten und Beschränkungen werden gemieden, die Antwort nennt die GO-mautpflichtigen Kilometer. Für Pkw (`driving`) lassen sich Maut und Autobahn meiden, dazu gibt es bis zu zwei Alternativen. Start und Ziel anklicken.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [15.4, 48.2], zoom: 8 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const pts = [], markers = [];

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('routes', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'routes', type: 'line', source: 'routes', layout: { 'line-cap': 'round' }, paint: { 'line-color': ['case', ['==', ['get', 'main'], 1], '#2346d8', '#9aa4b8'], 'line-width': ['case', ['==', ['get', 'main'], 1], 6, 4] } });
});
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove()); }
  pts.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());

async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes } = await res.json();
    map.getSource('routes').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: routes.map((r, i) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { main: i === 0 ? 1 : 0 }, geometry: r.geometry })).reverse() });
    const r = routes[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (routes.length > 1 ? `, ${routes.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, Maut: ASFINAG, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const routes = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const style = (f) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: f.get('main'), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: f.get('main') ? '#2346d8' : '#9aa4b8', width: f.get('main') ? 6 : 4, lineCap: 'round' }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: routes, style }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([15.4, 48.2]), zoom: 9 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const pts = [];

map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; points.clear(); routes.clear(); }
  pts.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  const m = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate));
  m.setStyle(pin(pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d'));
  points.addFeature(m);
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());

async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes: list } = await res.json();
    routes.clear();
    routes.addFeatures(list.map((r, i) => { const f = geojson.readFeature(r.geometry); f.set('main', i === 0 ? 1 : 0); return f; }));
    const r = list[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (list.length > 1 ? `, ${list.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Truck route: start and destination by click, vehicle size, avoid tolls and motorways, alternatives in grey.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style, the routing and the toll data (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, Maut: ASFINAG, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2, 15.4], 9);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const lines = L.geoJSON(null, { style: (f) => (f.properties.main ? { color: '#2346d8', weight: 6, opacity: 1 } : { color: '#9aa4b8', weight: 4, opacity: 1 }) }).addTo(map);
const markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const pts = [];
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.clearLayers(); lines.clearLayers(); }
  pts.push([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]);
  L.circleMarker(e.latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(markers);
  if (pts.length === 2) route();
});
for (const id of ['profile', 'toll', 'motorway', 'weight', 'height']) $(id).addEventListener('change', () => pts.length === 2 && route());
async function route() {
  const profile = $('profile').value, q = new URLSearchParams({ overview: 'full', geometries: 'geojson', alternatives: 'true' });
  if (profile === 'driving-truck') { q.set('weight', $('weight').value); q.set('height', $('height').value); q.delete('alternatives'); }
  const exclude = ['toll', 'motorway'].filter((k) => $(k).checked);
  if (profile === 'driving' && exclude.length) q.set('exclude', exclude.join(','));
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/${profile}/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?${q}`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const { routes } = await res.json();
    lines.clearLayers();
    // alternatives first, the main route last so it is drawn on top
    lines.addData(routes.map((r, i) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { main: i === 0 }, geometry: r.geometry })).reverse());
    const r = routes[0];
    $('info').textContent = `${(r.distance / 1000).toFixed(1)} km, ${Math.round(r.duration / 60)} min` + (r.toll?.truck_go_km != null ? `, ${r.toll.truck_go_km.toFixed(1)} km ${de ? 'GO-mautpflichtig' : 'subject to GO toll'}` : '') + (routes.length > 1 ? `, ${routes.length - 1} ${de ? 'Alternative(n)' : 'alternative(s)'}` : '');
  } catch (err) { $('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

# Tourenplanung: Beispiel Stopp-Reihenfolge

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/optimization/

> Haltestellen auf der Karte anklicken und die beste Reihenfolge ab Depot und zurück mit der mapx-Routenoptimierung erhalten: lauffähiges Beispiel.

Die Optimierung findet die beste Reihenfolge für eine Rundtour. Hier startet und endet das Fahrzeug in Melk. Bis zu neun Stopps anklicken, jeder Klick plant neu. Das Beispiel nutzt `GET /v1/optimized-trips/driving/{coordinates}` mit `source=first` und `roundtrip=true`; das geht mit dem öffentlichen Token, die Antwort enthält Reihenfolge und Strecke.

Für mehrere Fahrzeuge, Servicezeiten, Kapazitäten und Zeitfenster gibt es `POST /v1/optimization`. Das geht nur mit einem geheimen Token (`mx_sk_…`); ein öffentlicher Token bekommt `403 pk-not-allowed`. Diese Anfrage also über den eigenen Server schicken, nicht direkt aus der Webseite.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimized-trips API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
// Note: the richer POST /v1/optimization (time windows, capacities) needs a secret token (mx_sk_…); call it from your server.
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const depot = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: depot, zoom: 9 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const stops = [], markers = [];
let timer;
new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#222' }).setLngLat(depot).addTo(map);

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('tour', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'tour', type: 'line', source: 'tour', layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { 'line-color': '#2346d8', 'line-width': 5 } });
});
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (stops.length >= 9) return;
  stops.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  clearTimeout(timer); // plan once after the last click
  if (stops.length >= 2) timer = setTimeout(plan, 600);
});
document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stops.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove());
  map.getSource('tour').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] });
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = de ? 'Mindestens zwei Stopps anklicken.' : 'Click at least two stops.';
});

async function plan() {
  // Depot first, then the stops; source=first and roundtrip=true keep the depot as start and end.
  const coords = [depot, ...stops].map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/${coords}?source=first&roundtrip=true&geometries=geojson`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    const trip = data.trips[0];
    const order = data.waypoints.map((w, i) => ({ i, pos: w.waypoint_index })).filter((w) => w.i > 0).sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map((w) => w.i);
    map.getSource('tour').setData({ type: 'Feature', geometry: trip.geometry, properties: {} });
    document.getElementById('info').textContent = `${de ? 'Reihenfolge' : 'Order'}: ${order.join(' > ')}, ${(trip.distance / 1000).toFixed(0)} km, ${Math.round(trip.duration / 60)} min ${de ? 'Fahrzeit' : 'driving'}`;
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimized-trips API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Note: the richer POST /v1/optimization (time windows, capacities) needs a secret token (mx_sk_…); call it from your server.
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const depot = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk
const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const tour = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const line = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 5, lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round' }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: tour, style: line }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points, style: pin('#c8372d') })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat(depot), zoom: 10 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const depotMarker = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(ol.proj.fromLonLat(depot)));
depotMarker.setStyle(pin('#222'));
const stops = [];
let timer;
points.addFeature(depotMarker);

map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (stops.length >= 9) return;
  stops.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  points.addFeature(new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate)));
  clearTimeout(timer); // plan once after the last click
  if (stops.length >= 2) timer = setTimeout(plan, 600);
});
document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stops.length = 0; points.clear(); points.addFeature(depotMarker); tour.clear();
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = de ? 'Mindestens zwei Stopps anklicken.' : 'Click at least two stops.';
});

async function plan() {
  // Depot first, then the stops; source=first and roundtrip=true keep the depot as start and end.
  const coords = [depot, ...stops].map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/${coords}?source=first&roundtrip=true&geometries=geojson`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    const trip = data.trips[0];
    const order = data.waypoints.map((w, i) => ({ i, pos: w.waypoint_index })).filter((w) => w.i > 0).sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map((w) => w.i);
    tour.clear();
    tour.addFeature(geojson.readFeature(trip.geometry));
    document.getElementById('info').textContent = `${de ? 'Reihenfolge' : 'Order'}: ${order.join(' > ')}, ${(trip.distance / 1000).toFixed(0)} km, ${Math.round(trip.duration / 60)} min ${de ? 'Fahrzeit' : 'driving'}`;
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

### Leaflet

```html

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Tour planning: click stops (up to 9), the optimized-trips API finds the shortest order from the depot and back.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the routing (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const depot = [15.3294, 48.2272]; // Melk (lng, lat)
const map = L.map('map').setView([48.12, 15.33], 10); // depot in the upper half, room for stops to the south
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
const pin = (latlng, color) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: color, fillOpacity: 1 });
const tour = L.geoJSON(null, { style: { color: '#2346d8', weight: 5, opacity: 1 } }).addTo(map);
const markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
pin([depot[1], depot[0]], '#222').addTo(map);
const stops = [];
let timer;
map.on('click', (e) => {
  if (stops.length >= 9) return;
  stops.push([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]);
  pin(e.latlng, '#c8372d').addTo(markers);
  clearTimeout(timer); // plan once after the last click
  if (stops.length >= 2) timer = setTimeout(plan, 600);
});
document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stops.length = 0; markers.clearLayers(); tour.clearLayers();
  document.getElementById('info').textContent = de ? 'Mindestens zwei Stopps anklicken.' : 'Click at least two stops.';
});
async function plan() {
  // Depot first, then the stops; source=first and roundtrip=true keep the depot as start and end.
  const coords = [depot, ...stops].map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/${coords}?source=first&roundtrip=true&geometries=geojson`, AUTH);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    const trip = data.trips[0];
    const order = data.waypoints.map((w, i) => ({ i, pos: w.waypoint_index })).filter((w) => w.i > 0).sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map((w) => w.i);
    tour.clearLayers().addData(trip.geometry);
    document.getElementById('info').textContent = `${de ? 'Reihenfolge' : 'Order'}: ${order.join(' > ')}, ${(trip.distance / 1000).toFixed(0)} km, ${Math.round(trip.duration / 60)} min ${de ? 'Fahrzeit' : 'driving'}`;
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('info').textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
}
````

# ÖV-Verbindung: Beispiel

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/examples/transit-route/

> Start und Ziel anklicken und die Fuß- und Fahrabschnitte einer ÖV-Verbindung in Österreich mit der mapx-ÖV-API erhalten; lauffähiger Code.

Die Transit-API kombiniert Fußwege auf dem Wegenetz mit Fahrten aus dem Fahrplan. Ohne `depart_at` wird für jetzt geplant, `arrive_by` plant rückwärts. Fußabschnitte sind gestrichelt gezeichnet, Fahrten durchgezogen.

## Code

### MapLibre GL JS

````js
import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.19.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";

// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
// Adds the token to every request MapLibre makes to mapx.at (style, tiles, fonts, sprites), never to other hosts.
const transformRequest = (url) => ({ url: /^https:\/\/([\w-]+\.)?mapx\.at\//.test(url) ? url + (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'access_token=' + TOKEN : url });
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({ attributionControl: false, transformRequest, container: 'map', style: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets', center: [16.3725, 48.2085], zoom: 12 });
map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl());
map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: true }));
map.once('load', () => map.getContainer().querySelector('.maplibregl-compact-show')?.classList.remove('maplibregl-compact-show')); // start collapsed (MapLibre keeps it open until the first drag)
const pts = [], markers = [];

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('legs', { type: 'geojson', data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] } });
  const line = { 'line-width': 5 };
  map.addLayer({ id: 'legs-ride', type: 'line', source: 'legs', filter: ['!=', ['get', 'mode'], 'walking'], layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { ...line, 'line-color': '#2346d8' } });
  map.addLayer({ id: 'legs-walk', type: 'line', source: 'legs', filter: ['==', ['get', 'mode'], 'walking'], layout: { 'line-join': 'round' }, paint: { ...line, 'line-color': '#667', 'line-dasharray': [1, 1.5] } });
});
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.splice(0).forEach((m) => m.remove()); }
  pts.push([e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat]);
  markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({ color: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d' }).setLngLat(e.lngLat).addTo(map));
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    map.getSource('legs').setData({ type: 'FeatureCollection', features: route.legs.map((l) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { mode: l.mode }, geometry: l.geometry })) });
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### OpenLayers

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/ol.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/ol@10.11.0/dist/ol.js"></script>
```

````js
// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources (CC BY 4.0), must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>; Fahrplan/timetable: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG, Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG; <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>';

const base = new ol.layer.Tile({ source: new ol.source.XYZ({ url: 'https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, tileSize: 512, maxZoom: 20, attributions: ATTRIBUTION, attributionsCollapsible: false }) });
const legs = new ol.source.Vector(), points = new ol.source.Vector();
const ride = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#2346d8', width: 5, lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round' }) });
const walk = new ol.style.Style({ stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#667', width: 5, lineJoin: 'round', lineDash: [5, 7.5] }) });
const pin = (color) => new ol.style.Style({ zIndex: 1, image: new ol.style.Circle({ radius: 8, fill: new ol.style.Fill({ color }), stroke: new ol.style.Stroke({ color: '#fff', width: 2 }) }) });
const map = new ol.Map({ target: 'map', layers: [base, new ol.layer.Vector({ source: legs, style: (f) => (f.get('mode') === 'walking' ? walk : ride) }), new ol.layer.Vector({ source: points })], view: new ol.View({ center: ol.proj.fromLonLat([16.3725, 48.2085]), zoom: 13 }) });
const geojson = new ol.format.GeoJSON({ featureProjection: 'EPSG:3857' }); // reads lon/lat GeoJSON into map coordinates
const pts = [];

map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; points.clear(); legs.clear(); }
  pts.push(ol.proj.toLonLat(e.coordinate));
  const m = new ol.Feature(new ol.geom.Point(e.coordinate));
  m.setStyle(pin(pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d'));
  points.addFeature(m);
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    legs.addFeatures(route.legs.map((l) => { const f = geojson.readFeature(l.geometry); f.set('mode', l.mode); return f; }));
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

### Leaflet

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
```

````js
// Public transit: click start and destination, get walking and riding legs for the next departure.
const TOKEN = 'YOUR_TOKEN'; // your public token (mx_pk_…) from https://account.mapx.at
const AUTH = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + TOKEN } };
const de = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith('de'); // page language: German or English texts
// Data sources of the style and the timetables, must stay visible on the map; full text per source: https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution/
const ATTRIBUTION = '<a href="https://mapx.at">mapx.at</a>, <a href="https://www.bev.gv.at">BEV</a>, <a href="https://www.gip.gv.at">GIP.at</a>, <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>; Fahrplan: ÖBB-Personenverkehr AG (CC BY 4.0), Mobilitätsverbünde Österreich OG';

const map = L.map('map').setView([48.2085, 16.3725], 13);
L.tileLayer('https://api.mapx.at/v1/styles/streets/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}?access_token=' + TOKEN, { tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1, minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 21, attribution: ATTRIBUTION }).addTo(map);
// riding legs solid blue, walking legs dashed grey
const legs = L.geoJSON(null, { style: (f) => (f.properties.mode === 'walking' ? { color: '#667', weight: 5, opacity: 1, dashArray: '5 8' } : { color: '#2346d8', weight: 5, opacity: 1 }) }).addTo(map);
const markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const pts = [];
map.on('click', async (e) => {
  if (pts.length === 2) { pts.length = 0; markers.clearLayers(); legs.clearLayers(); }
  pts.push([e.latlng.lng, e.latlng.lat]);
  L.circleMarker(e.latlng, { radius: 8, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: pts.length === 1 ? '#1d7f4e' : '#c8372d', fillOpacity: 1 }).addTo(markers);
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  const info = document.getElementById('info');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/${pts.map((p) => p.join(',')).join(';')}?routes=1`, AUTH); // add depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00 for a fixed time
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).detail ?? 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    const route = (await res.json()).routes[0];
    legs.addData(route.legs.map((l) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { mode: l.mode }, geometry: l.geometry })));
    info.textContent = `${route.departure.slice(11, 16)} ${de ? 'bis' : 'to'} ${route.arrival.slice(11, 16)}, ${Math.round(route.duration / 60)} min, ${route.transfers} ${de ? 'Umstieg(e)' : 'transfer(s)'}: ` + route.legs.map((l) => l.summary).join(' > ');
  } catch (err) { info.textContent = (de ? 'Fehler: ' : 'Error: ') + err.message; }
});
````

## Verwendete APIs

- [Öffentlicher Verkehr](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/transit.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/{coordinates}`
- [Static Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/styles.md) `GET api.mapx.at/v1/styles/{id}/tiles/512/{z}/{x}/{y}` (OpenLayers, Leaflet)
